description: Election Commission - Declare That N. Saththiyaseelan and U. Latha as Members of the Valikaman East P.S.
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government body (Valikamam East Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of selected members to fill positions vacated by resignation, which falls under election-related matters rather than general government personnel appointments or structural changes.
